name: Li Shih-chih
bio: Li Shih-chih, who died in AD 747, was a minister of the T’ang dynasty and a friend of Li Po and Tu Fu. His poem here is on leaving office.
The poems here are Herbert A. Giles’s versions in Chinese Poetry in English Verse (1898), given with the poet’s name as spelled in that book.

poems.title: Out of Office
poems.author: Li Shih-chih
poems.text:
For my betters — my office resigned —
I make way,
And seek with the wine-cup to shorten the day.
You ask for the friends who once thronged in my hall:
Alas! with my place they have gone, one and all.
